title: The class 𝓜: local finiteness and the density representation μ = Hⁿ.withDensity(ofReal ∘ dens μ) (properties (1), (2); conditional on imrep_density_ae and blowup_imrep)
statement: Assume (DEN) — the frozen type of the selected node's registered dependency imrep_density_ae: for all P, n ∈ ℕ, all V, W ⊆ ℝ^P with W open and every IMRep R in V with R.measure(K ∩ W) ≠ ∞ for every compact K, for μHE[n]-a.e. x the ratio R.measure(B_ρ(x) ∩ W)/(ω_n·ofReal(ρⁿ)) (ω_n = unitBallVolume n) tends to 1_{R.carrier ∩ W}(x)·R.mult(x) in [0, ∞] as ρ → 0⁺. Assume also (BUI) — the frozen type of the selected node's registered dependency blowup_imrep (the reused accepted rep_pushforward): for all P, n ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^P, T ∈ 𝒟_n(U), x ∈ ℝ^P, λ > 0 and every IMRep R of T in U there is an IMRep R′ in dilation x λ '' U representing blowUp T x λ with R′.measure(s) = ofReal(λ⁻¹ⁿ)·R.measure((dilation x λ)⁻¹(s)) for every Borel s. Let n, k, ℓ ∈ ℕ with ℓ ≤ k and 1 ≤ n, let U ⊆ ℝ^{n+k} be open, N an embedded C² (n+ℓ)-dimensional submanifold with (closure N ∖ N) ∩ U = ∅, and T ∈ 𝒟_n(U) minimizing in U ∩ N with spt T ⊆ U ∩ N and ∂T = 0 in U. Let z ∈ ℝ^{n+k} and r > 0 with B̄_{2r}(z) ⊆ U, and let RT be an IMRep of T in U; write μ_T := RT.measure, W := B_{2r}(z) and η_{a,t} := dilation a t (η_{a,t}(v) = t⁻¹(v − a)). Let 𝓜 be a set of measures on ℝ^{n+k} such that μ ∈ 𝓜 if and only if either (PS) μ = ofReal(t⁻¹ⁿ) • (μ_T⌞W).map η_{a,t} for some a ∈ ℝ^{n+k} and some t with 0 < t ≤ r and dist(a, z) ≤ r − t; or (ZS) μ = RS.measure for some S ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^{n+k}) and some IMRep RS of S in ℝ^{n+k} for which there are points c_i, scales t_i > 0 (i ∈ ℕ) and a point b with dist(c_i, z) < r − t_i for every i, t_i → 0, c_i → b, and blowUp T c_i t_i ⇀ S in ℝ^{n+k} (ConvergesWeakly). (These are the selected node's positive-scale members μ_{x,λ} and zero-scale members, with (a, t) = (z + rx, rλ), c_i = z + rx_i, t_i = rλ_i, b = z + rx̄.) Let dens be a function of a measure and a point with dens μ x = (limsup_{ρ→0⁺} μ(B_ρ(x))/(ω_n·ofReal(ρⁿ))).toReal for all μ, x (limsup in [0, ∞] along 𝓝[>]0, ω_n = unitBallVolume n). Then (1) μ(K) ≠ ∞ for every μ ∈ 𝓜 and every compact K ⊆ ℝ^{n+k}; and (2) μ = Hⁿ.withDensity (x ↦ ofReal(dens μ x)) for every μ ∈ 𝓜, where Hⁿ = μHE[n].
